title: Point-BERT: Pre-training 3D Point Cloud Transformers with Masked Point Modeling
layout_note: Main pre-training pipeline on the left two-thirds (point cloud -> patches -> Mini-PointNet -> embeddings -> masking -> Transformer -> MPM head), a token-ID comparison in the middle, and a dashed rounded side panel at the right showing the dVAE tokenizer/decoder trained beforehand and frozen into the pipeline.
grouping: One dashed rounded panel at the right encloses the tokenizer training (tokenizer, token-ID set, decoder, reconstructed cloud). Point data sit in small blue dashed rounded frames (Input Point Cloud, Local Centers). Colour encodes patch identity: each point patch, its embedding and its prediction share one pastel colour (orange, blue, light blue, green, grey, yellow).
shapes_depth: Token sequences are rows of small rounded squares: solid pastel for input tokens, black-and-white checkerboard for masked tokens, diagonal hatching for predicted tokens, white for CLS. The Transformer encoder is a large white rounded rectangle with a blue outline; the MPM head is an orange bar; Mini-PointNet, tokenizer and decoder are trapezoids (yellow, green, grey). Point patches are dashed circles in pastel colours.
proposed_highlight: The masked-modelling idea is carried by token texture: checkerboard masked tokens entering the encoder and hatched predicted tokens leaving it, compared against the tokenizer's discrete IDs written as coloured numbers in curly braces with boxed mismatches; the large centred 'Transformer Encoder' box dominates.
lesson: Encode token state by texture (solid input, checkerboard masked, hatched predicted) and key it in a small corner legend, so a masked-prediction objective reads directly from the token rows above and below the encoder.
notes: venue = arXiv (remembered venue: CVPR 2022; not printed on the arXiv first page); year = arXiv preprint year. A 'Contrastive Leanring' label (typo in the figure) with an up arrow sits over the encoder output.

arrangement.units: left/centre: unframed pre-training pipeline around a large Transformer box; right: a dashed rounded panel with the tokenizer and decoder used to make discrete targets
arrangement.inputs_as: a grey point-cloud airplane in a blue dashed rounded frame at the top left, split into pastel dashed-circle point patches below it
arrangement.losses_at: beside the encoder output: the predicted token IDs are compared with tokenizer IDs by double-headed arrows between two curly-brace ID rows; 'Contrastive Leanring' arrow above the MPM head
arrangement.shared: the tokenizer appears twice: trained in the right dashed panel, then copied hatched into the pipeline with a blue 'Freeze' arrow between them

taxonomy.task: self-supervised pre-training of point cloud Transformers

core.what: masked point modeling: the MPM head's predicted token IDs (top row of curly-brace IDs) face the frozen tokenizer's target IDs (row below) with vertical double-headed arrows between matching positions, placed right of the large Transformer Encoder

relations.form: the patching runs down the left edge (input point cloud -> local centers -> dashed-circle patches -> normalize -> point patches), then right through a yellow Mini-PointNet trapezoid into a row of point embeddings under the encoder
the main tower reads bottom-up in the centre: point embeddings -> Token Masking bar -> masked token row with [cls] -> large Transformer Encoder box -> hatched predicted token row -> MPM head

two curly-brace rows of coloured IDs stacked right of the encoder, upper from the MPM head (curved arrow), lower from the hatched Tokenizer (fed by the unmasked embeddings via a long curved arrow), joined by vertical double arrows at the masked positions, which are boxed

the tokenizer pre-training is fenced in a dashed rounded panel at the far right (point embeddings -> green Tokenizer -> ID row -> Decoder -> reconstructed blue airplane), and a blue block arrow labeled 'Freeze' copies it as a hatched tokenizer into the main pipeline
local centers send a long curved 'Positional Embeddings' arrow into the masked token row under the encoder
the input is a real grey airplane point cloud and its patches are overlapping pastel dashed circles over the point scatter

channels.colour: pastel fill = patch identity, carried from patch circles to embeddings, tokens and ID digits; the same colour channel also marks module types (yellow Mini-PointNet, orange MPM head, green tokenizer), so colour carries two meanings
channels.shape: rounded small squares = tokens, dashed circles = point patches, trapezoids = tokenizer/decoder/Mini-PointNet, large rounded rectangle = encoder; token state is a texture (solid input, checkerboard masked, hatched predicted, white CLS), keyed in a corner legend
channels.line: solid black arrows for data flow, curved where they cross the figure; vertical double-headed arrows mark the ID comparison; a blue block arrow for the freeze copy
channels.frame: dashed rounded frames group the input cloud, local centers, and the separate tokenizer-training stage; the encoder is a plain large frame

quality.strengths: the compared nouns are drawn as data - two rows of actual coloured token IDs with double arrows at the masked positions - so what the loss matches is visible; masked/predicted states are textures keyed once and reused; the separately trained tokenizer is spatially quarantined in its own dashed panel with an explicit 'Freeze' hand-off
quality.weaknesses: the large Transformer Encoder box takes the most area although it is a standard block, while the ID comparison is small; long curved arrows (positional embeddings, embeddings to tokenizer, MPM head to IDs) sweep across the figure instead of short straight runs; 'Contrastive Leanring' is a bare upward arrow with a typo and no drawn partner; colour mixes patch identity and module type

insights.structure: A large white Transformer Encoder box sits centre-left with token rows above and below it, the patching steps run down the left edge, and the tokenizer pre-training is fenced off in a dashed panel at the right.
insights.data: Point clouds are drawn as dot scatters and patches as pastel dashed circles whose colours carry through to embeddings and predicted tokens; discrete token IDs are written as coloured numbers inside curly braces.
insights.emphasis: Checkerboard masked tokens and hatched predicted tokens, keyed in a four-entry corner legend, make the masked prediction the visual centre, with mismatched IDs boxed in black.
insights.flow: The pipeline goes down the left column, right along the bottom embedding row, up through masking and the encoder to the MPM head, then a curved arrow carries predictions right to the ID comparison; the right panel feeds in from the right via the 'Freeze' arrow.
insights.avoid: The U-shaped reading path (down, right, up, right) plus a right-to-left freeze arrow makes the order hard to follow, and the 'Contrastive Leanring' label is a typo floating above the head.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
